# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Record the location of the source of the emission.
3. Note the threshold.
4. Note the time and date of the emission.
5. Describe the emission.
6. Note any contributing factors.

In July 2024, the GreenTech Plant emitted 1,500 pounds of particulate matter into the air, exceeding the EPA threshold of 1,000 pounds. The emission originated from the plant’s Unit 3 smokestack, which is located at 34.0522° N, 118.2437° W. The emission occurred on July 14, 2024, at 14:30 PST. The emission appeared as a visible plume of dark gray smoke. A malfunctioning filter in Unit 3 is believed to be the primary contributor to the excess emission.
